scope: Documentary support for independently inferred search extents; no claim of exact formal zoning boundaries

facts.name: Belváros
facts.fact: The municipal2008IVS identifies Óvár belváros separately from Városközpont and Mosoni belváros, using named street/river circuits. Its complete statistical unit includes surrounding castle/park sectors, so it is not blindly copied to the narrow historical-centre label.

facts.name: Belváros
facts.fact: The municipal2017townscape handbook distinguishes historic downtown, castle surroundings and Wittmann park, and associates downtown with the Fő/Magyar street area plus the Kötélgyártó/Lakatos/Győrikapu/Tímár historic street fabric. This supports an independent narrower parent-child extent rather than equating Belváros with broad Magyaróvár.

facts.name: Belváros
facts.fact: The local building code names Fő utca, Magyar utca, Városkapu tér and Malom-ági Lajta as historic-centre streets/frontages. The output's selected enclosing road/river circuit is an inference, not a traced ordinance zoning line.

facts.name: Dunapart
facts.fact: The municipal strategy associates the waterfront with Fazekas/Rév/Partos/Gabonarakpart and the Mosoni-Duna. The named Dunapart label and native residential/access-street geometry narrow that broader programme area. The output is an approximate landward neighbourhood, not the complete action area or a river polygon.

facts.name: Dunapart
facts.fact: The OSM-derived street directory associates Petőfi Sándor utca with Dunapart and names adjacent Fazekas/Duna streets; this is supporting identity/location evidence only.

sourceGeometry: Original native OSM roads, river lines and named-point evidence were already archived in the prior Mosonmagyaróvár packet and copied unchanged here. No network downloads are needed for normal reconstruction.
